facility_roles.note: The design paper names the proton-decay hall of Soudan; the Atlas's only Soudan site is the MINOS far-detector cavern. CoGeNT sat in the Soudan-2 (proton-decay) hall: the PRD paper says its shield rests on 'base I-beams that once supported the Soudan-2 proton decay experiment' at 2090 m.w.e., whereas the Atlas's only Soudan site is the MINOS far-detector cavern (2070 m.w.e.). They are different halls of the same mine level; no source read gives the Soudan-2 hall's coordinates, so the MINOS-cavern point stands for the laboratory.
facility_roles.quote: The present plan is to locate the C-4 dark matter experiment in the proton-decay hall of the Soudan Underground Laboratory (2800 m.w.e. overburden), the same location as the CoGeNT and CDMS-II experiments.

intervals.label: design of the C-4 expansion
intervals.note: Start: arXiv submission of the NIM A 712 (2013) design paper (23 October 2012). The January 2014 CoGeNT paper calls C-4 'the ongoing CoGeNT upgrade', but no approval, construction or first-data date was found in the sources read (a 2016 paper describes a 1.2 kg PPC crystal and cryostat 'intended for use in a direct detection search for low mass, WIMP dark matter'). Status 'proposed' is the last documented state and may be stale in 2026.
intervals.quote: We describe the experimental design of C-4, an expansion of the CoGeNT dark matter search to four identical detectors each approximately three times the mass of the p-type point contact germanium diode presently taking data at the Soudan Underground Laboratory.

quantity.quote: C-4 operation with a 4.1 kg target mass

name: C-4
notes: external.inspire_experiment is null: INSPIRE was not consulted (its rate budget belongs to the supervised importer).

Status 'proposed': a published design report names the Soudan proton-decay hall; no later source read reports approval, construction or data. C-4's 2800 m.w.e. figure differs from the 2090 m.w.e. in the CoGeNT paper for the same laboratory (both recorded in their own papers' words).

physics_goals.quote: The C-4 dark matter experiment is intended to test recent results from the CoGeNT experiment
physics_goals.value: Test the CoGeNT low-energy excess and annual modulation with four detectors, lower background and larger mass

summary.plain: C-4 was designed as a bigger version of CoGeNT: four germanium detectors, each about three times heavier, in a better-shielded setup in the Soudan mine, to test CoGeNT's low-energy excess. Only the design paper was read; no result or start of data taking was found.
summary.technical: Design for four identical p-type point-contact germanium detectors (up to ~1.3 kg each, ~4.1 kg total) in one low-background shield with a plastic-scintillator veto, in the proton-decay hall of Soudan (2800 m.w.e. quoted), aiming at ~0.5 keVee thresholds, ~5x lower background than CoGeNT and sensitivity to ~1e-42 cm^2 at 10 GeV/c^2 after 8 months.
